response.sql: WITH rentals_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_average FROM rentals_by_rating) SELECT AVG(rbr.rental_count) AS average_rentals_above_average, AVG(rbr.rental_count - ra.overall_average) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM rentals_by_rating AS rbr CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rbr.rental_count > ra.overall_average
